title: Imagine If:
title_short: Balloons · Justine · My Calm to My Storm
headline: Where do you find peace? In one person who listens and does not judge you.
story: Kalindi asks a woman in a New York park how she finds peace. Justine says she goes into herself, or she talks to her wife: the only person she can be fully open with and not feel judged.
She's my calm to my storm. Peace starts with one person who listens. Then the balloons go up. Warm and hopeful. One person, about 22 seconds.
do: Open on frame 1 with Justine speaking and “MY CALM TO MY STORM” on screen.
Show Kalindi’s question as text, in her exact words.
Let her say “we're married” as she says it. No text or pictures about it.
Show the sign once, long enough to read.
Cut from the MXF. Match the look and pacing of the approved Balloon Release montage.
dont: Not about marriage as a topic, politics, or balloons as a toy.
Do not use her wish line 1:39.0–1:45.9. The montage already uses it.
Do not reuse release seconds 0:42–0:45 or 0:50 (Susan video).
No name super. No place name. No animation in the middle.

Audio is in the camera. The MXF has several mono tracks. Solo each track and use the one with the clear voice. We did not measure the channels here.
−14 LUFS integrated, −1 dBTP peak. Any music 18–20 dB under the voice.
